📖 How to use

  1. Enter the buy price, sell price and amount of coins/tokens.
  2. Add the exchange fee percentages for buying and selling.
  3. Read your net profit or loss and ROI.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are fees handled?

Buy fees increase your cost basis; sell fees reduce your proceeds. Both are deducted before profit is computed.

What does ROI mean here?

Return on investment = net profit ÷ total invested (including buy fees), as a percent.

Does this handle taxes?

No. Crypto-to-crypto trades and sales may be taxable events in your country — consult a tax professional.
